messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - high error rate (429) from runtime-gateway eu-west-1. Start an incident channel: https://console.redwood.ai/incident/4259003000
oncall-dan: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking dashboards.
eng-runtime-raj: looking now, I see a sharp increase in queue depth and timeouts on worker pool gp-runtime-3. Tail latency spiked ~3x at 17:04 UTC.
sre-maya: confirmed 429s coming from the runtime reverse-proxy, upstreams returning 503s intermittently. Could be overloaded in-flight slots.
support-lina: received 6 customer tickets in the last 8 minutes complaining about slow responses and errors, two mention generation timeouts.
oncall-dan: requesting mitigation options: adjust max-inflight, enable soft shedding for low-priority routes, or rate-limit free-tier. Which one is fastest?
eng-runtime-raj: fastest is config tweak: set-max-inflight on gp-runtime-3 from 1000 -> 300, enable soft-shedding for /v1/embeddings and /v1/batch-generate, and temporarily flip feature-flag webhooks.offload to false. I can push the changes in ~3m.
sre-maya: add traffic shaping at edge: reduce per-ip concurrent requests for anonymous accounts to 2. That will protect critical tokenized traffic.
oncall-dan: do it. runbook says to annotate incident ticket with mitigations. I'll page CS for customer heads-up.
eng-runtime-raj: executing commands: 
```
# runtimectl (internal)
runtimectl set-max-inflight --pool gp-runtime-3 --value 300 --reason "emergency shedding 4259003000"
runtimectl enable-soft-shedding --routes "/v1/embeddings,/v1/batch-generate" --threshold 0.7
feature-flags set webhooks.offload false --env production
```
incident-bot: ChangeSet applied by eng-runtime-raj at 17:07 UTC. CI checks passed, rollout to gp-runtime-3 started.
eng-runtime-raj: monitoring now. initial backpressure observed, queue depth for gp-runtime-3 dropping. 429s down 60% in 90s.
support-lina: pushing templates to affected customers: "We're seeing degraded performance; applied traffic-shaping to prioritize paid requests; will update in 15m." customer-success-anne: I'll DM top customers and offer SLA credits if impact persists.
backend-lee: FYI one internal job is high fanout on embeddings that may be hitting quota; I throttled the job and queued its workers.
sre-maya: watch for error-class shift from 429 -> 504 or downstream timeouts, lowering max-inflight can surface other issues. Keep an eye on retry storms.
oncall-dan: good call. eng-runtime-raj can you add short timeout change to avoid long tail blocking: request-timeout 60s -> 30s for batch-generate route?
eng-runtime-raj: applying: `runtimectl set-timeout --route /v1/batch-generate --timeout 30s` now.
incident-bot: Alert: increased 504s for legacy webhook service after feature-flag change. eng-runtime-raj, rollback webhooks.offload or route traffic away?
eng-runtime-raj: rolling back webhooks.offload to true and moving webhooks traffic to dedicated pool webhooks-pool-1. Command: `runtimectl route --service webhooks --pool webhooks-pool-1`
eng-runtime-raj: rollback done and reroute in progress. 504s dropping. overall 429s stayed low and tail latency improving.
support-lina: updated customers with next ETA 30m + note on mitigations. no escalations so far.
oncall-dan: summary so far: reduced max-inflight, enabled soft shedding on non-critical routes, temporary per-ip concurrency cap for anonymous, reduced timeouts for batch, rolled back webhook offload to avoid regressions.
sre-maya: recommend keeping these mitigations for 20 minutes while we observe, then gradual restore if stable. Also run a canary with slower ramp to see if we can increase max-inflight to 500 safely.
eng-runtime-raj: agreed. starting 20m observation window. setting alert thresholds tighter for errors and queue depth.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status = mitigated, phase = monitoring. https://console.redwood.ai/incident/4259003000
customer-success-anne: I'll do proactive outreach to the three affected accounts and flag for credits if SLA hit.
oncall-dan: if things stay stable after 20m we'll sign off and postmortem. thanks everyone for quick response. :thumbsup:
eng-runtime-raj: quick note for postmortem: investigate cause of sudden high queueing (likely large fanout batch jobs + embedding pipeline), and add guardrails to avoid single-job overload.
sre-maya: logging escalation: add more granular SLOs per-route, and automated temporary throttles for high-cost routes.
incident-bot: Incident closed for paging, final status: mitigated -> monitoring -> resolved after 45m. Logs and change history saved to: https://console.redwood.ai/incident/4259003000/logs
